# `Q-2-30` — Multi-Paragraph Footnote Indentation Not Supported

> A multi-paragraph indented block following a footnote
> definition is Pandoc syntax that Quarto markdown does not
> support.

## What this means

In Pandoc, indenting multiple paragraphs under a footnote label
attaches all of them to the footnote:

```markdown
[^1]:
    First paragraph of the footnote.

    Second paragraph, also part of the footnote.
```

Quarto markdown does not parse that form. Use the fenced-div
footnote form instead, with multiple paragraphs inside the div.

## How to fix

Convert to the div form:

```markdown
::: ^1
First paragraph of the footnote.

Second paragraph, also part of the footnote.
:::
```

The reference inside the div must match the reference in the
text.
